verdict.rationale: Docs confirm building and sharing rich, customizable dashboards with high-density interactive visualizations and public share URLs (new-relic-docs-7, -8, -26, -27, -35), and NRQL underpins chart creation (new-relic-docs-3, -21). However, no evidence explicitly documents template variables (dashboard-level parameterization) as a supported feature. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of template variables/parameterized dashboards, independent hands-on corroboration of dashboard-building workflow.
